title: ArtifactVersion
description: One immutable, hash-checked, owner-scoped version in the artifact store (ADR-0018, FR-MEM-12; PRD 13.2, 15.1): the metadata record at orgs/{org}/worlds/{world}/artifacts/{artifact_id}/versions/{version:06d}. The bytes live under a key derived from the ids, so the record holds no blob path. Read by the harness, tilo-api, tilo-render and erasure; only the store writes it. Rules the schema cannot express are AR-01 to AR-10 in artifact.rules.md. 1.1.0 (ADR-0029) adds the fetch origin: a file a unit downloaded through tilo-browser. 1.2.0 (ADR-0050) lets a writer unit store one self-contained HTML file for a website deliverable, at most 524,288 bytes; an upload never stores HTML (AR-10). 1.3.0 (ADR-0051) adds the browser origin: a masked screenshot (PNG) of an agentic browser step (AR-11).

size_bytes.description: Stored size: at least 1 byte, at most 50,000,000 for a file and 2,000,000 for text or JSON (BQ-257, AR-04).

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex; every read recomputes it (AR-01).

parents.description: The earlier version of the same artifact this one continues, or the version a restore copies (AR-02); empty for version 1.

sources.description: Raw-archive pointers of the version's sources, for the Verifier (FR-CON-10, FR-AGT-12): records of the record's own run for a unit, render or fetch output (a fetch has exactly one, the fetch's own record, which holds the cleaned URL, BQ-104), the copied version's for a restore, none for an upload (AR-03, AR-09). They never leave Tilo (AR-06).

screening.description: The SafetyProvider verdict on the exact stored bytes (PRD 16.3 item 2), unscreened when there is none. A version that is not clean raises safety_flag in the policy engine (AR-07).

screened_at.description: When that verdict came back; null exactly when screening is unscreened (AR-07).

redacted.description: true when the secret redactor changed text or JSON before it was stored (SEC-01, BQ-258). The redactor reads only text and JSON, so false on a file means it did not run (AR-07).

idempotency_key.description: Set for unit, render and fetch outputs (AR-05); null for uploads, restores and browser frames (AR-11).

then.description: A model writes only text and JSON, never a file (ADR-0018 1); since 1.2.0 also one self-contained HTML file for a website, after the static checks (ADR-0050, AR-10).

else.description: tilo-render makes only files, and a fetch keeps only files (ADR-0029 8: never HTML, SVG, an archive or a program).

then.description: A fetch has its own key form and exactly one source, the fetch's raw-archive record (AR-09).
An upload has no archive sources and is never HTML (AR-10): a website is only ever a writer unit's output.
A browser frame is one masked PNG screenshot that tilo-browser took for a unit's agentic browser step; no archive sources and no key (AR-11).

media_type.description: Text and JSON are at most 2,000,000 bytes (BQ-257) and a website's HTML at most 524,288 (ADR-0050, AR-10). Keyed by a required field, so it always applies; the root keeps one if/then/else.

screening.description: clean and flagged carry the verdict's time; unscreened has none (AR-07).

origin.description: What made the version: a unit's runner (unit and the worker agent set), tilo-render (for a unit), an intake upload (neither), a restore (FR-MEM-06; no unit) or, since 1.1.0 (ADR-0029), a fetch: a file a unit's worker agent downloaded through tilo-browser (unit and agent set), or, since 1.3.0 (ADR-0051), a browser frame: a masked screenshot of a unit's agentic browser step (unit and agent set). Set by the store from the run, never by a runner.

source.description: Where one source's text is in the raw archive: id is the manifest source id, archive_ref the tool call record. A pointer, never content.

idempotency_key.description: <run_id>:<unit_id>:<attempt>:<index> (AR-05). index is the output's 0-based position, 0 to 9, since a unit has at most 10 outputs (BQ-257); a fetch's index is f0 to f9, the file's 0-based position among the unit's fetched files, at most 10 (FR-INT-01, ADR-0029 8).

manifest_revision.description: One append-only revision of a version's provenance manifest, at .../versions/{version:06d}/manifests/{n:04d} (AR-06): created at put, reviewed after the Verifier (cause its artifact.reviewed), sent (cause the data.transfer out) or exported when the version leaves Tilo. Readers take the highest n.
